listing.summary: Simple officer respecs. Safe to add or remove to ongoing saves. Compatible with officer extension.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a mastery experience system that allows officers to respec their skills without changing their level.

description: Officers gain mastery experience from combat when at max level, with a portion contributing to a global pool. This experience can be spent to reset an officer's vanilla and elite skills, similar to AI cores. The global pool can cover costs if an individual officer lacks sufficient personal experience.

discordPostHtml:
Simple officer respecs. Safe to add or remove to ongoing saves. Compatible with officer extension.

  • Respec officers using a new system called "mastery experience".
  • Mastery experience is gained per-officer from combat while at max level.
  • An additional 10% of mastery exp gained is gained as global mastery exp.
  • A respec costs the exp needed to reach the officer's level from level 1.
  • Global mastery exp can substitute for officer mastery exp if insufficient.
  • All vanilla combat skills and elite skills may be changed (like AI cores!)
  • Officer levels are never modified.
